body.content: A specific candidate derived from a 4x4 grid (0, 1/3, 2/3, 1) missing the corner (1,1): Points are (i/3, j/3) for i=0..3, j=0..2 and (1/2, 1). This configuration has multiple colinear triples on grid lines, resulting in a minimum area of 0. To fix this, we can apply a global perturbation: e.g., x' = x + 0.01 * sin(y * 10), y' = y + 0.01 * cos(x * 10). This breaks all colinearities. The minimum triangle area needs to be calculated; it will be very small but non-zero. The challenge is maximizing this minimum area through optimal perturbation magnitudes and functions.
body.why_keep_this: Documents a concrete starting point for numerical optimization.
